scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Purchase Solar Power Unit/Kit for Solar Fencing around the Farm
other_conditions: The applicant must be a farmer
For joint landholder farmers, only the landholder named in the 8‑A land record is eligible
The selected joint landholder must obtain consent of all other joint landholders
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 50% of the cost or ₹15,000 (whichever is lower) for a solar power unit/kit, grantable once every ten years.
